excerpt.zh: 还有另外一支效忠于[radical_cult.GetName]的异教徒舰队出现在了[Root.GetStarName]星系。不过这次，他们之中混入了一艘设计陌生的飞船！
excerpt.en: Yet another cultist fleet loyal to the [radical_cult.GetName] has been sighted in the [Root.GetStarName] system. This time, however, their numbers include a strange ship of an unfamiliar design!

triggers.en: When a fleet enters a system
